name: merge_state
description: Merges two attention partial states. Let p=prefix_lse.float(), s=suffix_lse.float(), mapping +inf to -inf. Compute max_lse=max(p,s), p_se=exp(p-max_lse), s_se=exp(s-max_lse), out_se=p_se+s_se, output_lse=log(out_se)+max_lse, and output=prefix_output*(p_se/out_se)+suffix_output*(s_se/out_se). Returns (output,output_lse) with the shapes/dtypes of prefix_output and prefix_lse. Current tests exercise bfloat16 outputs and float32 lse with head_size 64/128/512; inputs are not mutated.
